For the petitioners : Md. Asadul Haque, Advocate For the State : Mr. Tarun Kumar, A.P.P.
-----
03/13.09.2024

The petitioners are apprehending their arrest for the offences punishable under
Sections 420/294-A/34 Ipc and Section 7(3) of Lottery Regulation Act, 1998.
2.  Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners have been falsely implicated in the present case and have not committed any offence as alleged in the F.I.R.

Even on perusal of the written report of the informant, it would be evident that the house in question from where there is alleged recovery of lottery tickets along with the machines used for printing and cutting the same,
was taken on rent by co-accused Rahul Mandal.
The petitioners have been implicated in this case merely on the statement of the landlord of the said house, namely, Bharat Tirthani that 5-6 more persons used to live there.
Except the said fact, there is no other cogent material to connect the petitioners with the alleged offence.
Moreover, co-accused Bipin Kumar Yadav @ Bipin Kumar has already been granted anticipatory bail by this Court vide order dated 10.09.2024 passed in A.B.A No. 5740 of 2024.
The petitioners undertake to co-operate in the ongoing investigation.
Hence, they may be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
3. Learned A.P.P opposes the petitioners' prayer for anticipatory bail.
4. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the materials available on record, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioners on anticipatory bail.

Accordingly, the petitioners above named, in the event of their arrest/surrender within three weeks from today, shall be released on Bittu Bhagat @ Kamal Kumar Bhagat @ Bittu ... vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...
